51570260.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to ILF3 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant at upto 1 uM by SPR method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Binding Affinity Measurement by SPR. ILF3/NF110 was diluted in 200 μg/mL sodium acetate buffer at pH 5.0 and immobilized using the CMS chip amino coupling method on channel 3, with channel 1 as the reference channel for activation and blocking treatment, and the activation and blocking time of the chip was 420 s. The final immobilized protein about 9984 RU was obtained. After solvent correction according to the instructions, AQIM-I was configured into a series of concentrations (from 1 to 0.0625 μM), and its affinity dissociation data with ILF3/NF110 were measured using a Biacore T200 biosensor system (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 10 caption: Figure 10. SPR measurement of the binding between AQIM-I/YM155 and ILF3/NF110. (A) Biacore analysis of the affinity between AQIM-I and ILF3/NF110. Concentrations of AQIM-I were 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 μM, respectively. (B) Biacore analysis of the affinity between YM155 and ILF3/NF110. Concentrations of YM155 were 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 μM, respectively. (C) The affinity constants of AQIM-I and YM155 for interactions with ILF3/NF110.
